'''Thurrb''' were [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] mammalian<ref name="description" /> creatures in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] used as mounts around [[3626 BBY]]. They were known to be helpful as beasts of burden. They were prized for their bottom canine and though visually intimidating, Thurrb were typically found to be only mildly temperamental,<ref name="description" /> generally friendly and docile; though they had a tendency to slobber all over unsuspecting individuals who got too close to their large mouths.<ref name="Onslaught">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]''</ref> 

There were a number of Thurrb variants, including "Earthen,"<ref name="Reveal">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20201103|text=SWTOR In-Game Events for November}}</ref> "Tellurian," "Brumal," "Conflagrant",<ref name="Galactic Season 2">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20220215|text=Galactic Seasons 2: 'Shadows of the Underworld'}}</ref> and "Natatorial" Thurrbs.<ref name="description" />

==Behind the scenes==
Thurrb appear in the [[2019]]'s sixth expansion to the videogame ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', called [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']]. The species first debuted as an ownable in-game pet,<ref name="Reveal" /> though rideable Thurrb mounts were later added to the game in the [[2022]] expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith|''Legacy of the Sith'']]'s "Galactic Season 2: 'Shadows of the Underworld'" which launched on [[February 15]], [[2022]].<ref name="Galactic Season 2" />
